title: telemetry tests: verify new events with validate_telemetry_record for end-to-end calls and by mocking _record_event for env_pack success and failure
answers: How do I write a test that checks a new telemetry event is sent when I call mlflow.register_model or Model.log?
How do I test that the env_pack telemetry records success or failure correctly?
What fixtures do I use to check telemetry parameters in the tests?
body:
Path: tests/telemetry/test_tracked_events.py covers end-to-end events by calling the public API (mlflow.pyfunc.log_model, mlflow.register_model) with the mock_requests and mock_telemetry_client fixtures and checking the record with validate_telemetry_record(mock_telemetry_client, mock_requests, <event name>, <params>). tests/telemetry/test_events.py covers parse() directly with parametrized argument dicts, including SimpleNamespace stand-ins for flavor and env_pack objects.
Rule: For a new event, add a parametrized parse() test that covers known values, None, and an unknown value mapping to "other". Add one end-to-end test in test_tracked_events.py. For env_pack, patch mlflow.telemetry.track._record_event and assert on the call args: the event class, the params dict, and the success and duration_ms kwargs. Build the packable model with a tmp_path artifacts directory whose MLmodel has databricks_runtime set, and patch mlflow.utils.env_pack.download_artifacts and sys.prefix.
Symptom: Not applicable; this is a testing convention.
Constraints: Patch _record_event at mlflow.telemetry.track, not at events, because env_pack imports it lazily from there. Does not cover the real network upload path.
applies: Writing or changing tests for telemetry events in tests/telemetry or for telemetry emitted from mlflow/utils/env_pack.py.
says: Track usage analytics whenever users log models or register models in the catalog.
Record telemetry on whether packaging environment dependencies for model serving succeeded or failed.
Measure the duration and success rate when packaging environments for model deployment.
Ensure telemetry metrics are accurately recorded when logging or registering models.
search: Testing telemetry events requires adding parametrized parse() tests for known, None, and other values, an end-to-end test via validate_telemetry_record, and patching mlflow.telemetry.track._record_event for env_pack. In tests/telemetry/test_tracked_events.py, end-to-end events are checked by calling mlflow.pyfunc.log_model or mlflow.register_model with mock_requests and mock_telemetry_client fixtures, while env_pack tests assert on event class, params, success, and duration_ms. Packable models require an MLmodel with databricks_runtime set alongside patched download_artifacts and sys.prefix, _record_event must be patched at mlflow.telemetry.track due to lazy imports, and the real network upload path is not covered.
